candidate.name: intraday_above_median_amount_longest_run_240m
candidate.mechanism: normalized longest within-half-session duration of a strict above-full-session-median amount state
candidate.formula: ordinary median m of exact a_0..a_239; b_i=1[a_i>m]; L=max(longest one-run on b_0..b_119, longest one-run on b_120..b_239); score=L/120

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Multiply every one of the 240 amount values by the same finite positive constant.
Apply the same strictly increasing finite transform to all 240 amounts.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign080_result: unchanged because strict membership above the ordinary even-sample median is determined by order and median ties, both preserved
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: amount entropy, concentration, dispersion, center-of-mass, and magnitude-correlation statistics

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Reverse minute order separately inside both 120-bar halves while retaining the same half membership.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: peak recency, center of mass, late-window share, and terminal-bar share

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Permute a fixed amount multiset within a half so the above-median bars form one contiguous block instead of isolated minutes.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign080_result: generally increases while the amount multiset and amount entropy remain unchanged

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Split one fixed above-median block into separated high bars without changing the high-bar count or values.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: threshold exceedance count, amount mass, and concentration

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Place an above-median suffix at 11:30 and prefix at 13:01 while holding each half's other binary states fixed.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign080_result: does not join the two runs

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Hold the complete amount path fixed while changing every minute and daily OHLC, return, range, transaction price, financial statement value, issuer event, turnover field, and market-peer path.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_local_peak_density_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both use ordinal topology of the exact one-session amount path
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign078 counts strict adjacent local maxima across the concatenated continuous grid; Campaign080 thresholds against the full-session median and retains only the longest persistent high-state duration without crossing lunch. A fixed local-peak count can have different longest high-state runs, and a fixed longest run can contain different local-peak counts.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_profile_serial_persistence_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both depend on the ordering of intraday amount bars
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: serial persistence uses adjacent amount magnitudes and their linear association; Campaign080 is an ordinal binary duration statistic invariant to every common strictly increasing transform and ignores below/above-median magnitudes

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_participation_entropy_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both summarize the full-session amount path
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: entropy changes with normalized amount probabilities and ignores order; Campaign080 ignores magnitude changes preserving order but changes when the same amount multiset is temporally fragmented

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_clock_dispersion_240m and intraday_amount_center_of_mass_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: all use the exact amount grid
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factors are amount-weighted absolute-clock moments; Campaign080 uses no amount weights or absolute clock coordinates beyond the frozen lunch discontinuity

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_peak_amount_bar_recency_240m, late_amount_share_30m, and intraday_terminal_bar_amount_share_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: all can respond to a late high-activity episode
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factors retain absolute timing or mass; Campaign080 is unchanged by reversal within each half and retains only the longest high-state duration

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_morning_afternoon_amount_profile_similarity_120b, intraday_day_over_day_amount_profile_similarity_240b, and intraday_market_amount_profile_synchronization_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factors correlate magnitudes with another half, day, or market profile; Campaign080 uses one session, one order threshold, and no reference profile

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: signal_day_turnover_rate_pct
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign079's rejected definition is a daily aggregate turnover level from daily_basic; Campaign080 is an intraday ordinal state-duration topology computed from minute amounts and is invariant to nominal activity scaling

nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: the structurally nonnumeric definition remains in the complete semantic library
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: peer-standardized return-state mobility versus single-stock amount-path high-state duration
